Cc: accounts-payable@solenovo.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding invite — cannot complete 'Verify email' step

Hi Priya,

We're trying to finish vendor setup for Solenovo (AP team) but the invite sent yesterday to vendor@solenovo.com lands on the supplier portal and never advances past the "Verify email" step. The page shows a generic error: "This email is already associated with another account" and there's no link to proceed.

I attached a quick screenshot of the portal state and our vendor CSV export with the contact used for the invite. Can you confirm what the portal expects here? We need the supplier profile created so PO GRNs can be processed — we're blocked on a live PO for an urgent hardware order.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Senior AP Analyst
Solenovo Ltd.

Attachment: screenshot-verify-step.png (image/png)
Attachment: solenovo_vendor_details.csv (text/csv)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood-inference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@solenovo.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding invite — cannot complete 'Verify email' step

Hi Liam — thanks for the details and the attachments. Sorry for the disruption.

Quick context: Redwood's supplier portal will reject an invite when the invite email is normalized to a mailbox that already exists in our tenant (either from a prior supplier record or an alias). Ben and Monica — can you review the attachment and check whether vendor@solenovo.com is colliding with an existing account? Rafael, can you please pull the invite/log entries for the Solenovo tenant (search by domain and by the invite token timestamp)?

Liam — in parallel, could you try an alternate invite address (eg ap+redwood@solenovo.com) we can send to as a stop-gap while we investigate? If you prefer, we can reissue the invite to a new address and merge the supplier profiles after creation.

I'll triage on our side and update you by EOD.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Partner Ops (Onboarding)
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood-inference.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@solenovo.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding invite — cannot complete 'Verify email' step

Thanks Priya — quick status from platform ops: we found a legacy supplier profile created in 2023 where vendor@solenovo.com was used as a secondary contact and the email was later converted to an alias under a different tenant. Our invite flow currently blocks when an invite email maps (via alias normalization) to an existing internal supplier identity — intended to prevent duplicate supplier creation but unsurprisingly causes these UX dead-ends for new invites.

Planned remediation steps:
- Rafael will generate a scoped invite token that bypasses alias normalization for this tenant only (temporary workaround).
- If that succeeds, we'll create the fresh supplier profile and then merge the legacy record (audit trail preserved).
- We'll also add a short-hold fix in the UI to surface the collision reason instead of a generic error.

Liam — can you confirm an alternate recipient for the invite? If you can send ap+redwood@solenovo.com we will use the scoped token approach and then communicate next steps for profile merge. If you'd rather we issue to a personal address (team lead), tell us which.

Rafael — please pull the invite logs for Jan 14–16 for domain solenovo.com and return the invite token id. I put a high priority on this because it's blocking an active PO.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales Engineer — Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Hi Ben / Priya — thanks for the fast follow-up. We've asked our IT to create ap+redwood@solenovo.com (simple mailbox alias) and I'll confirm when it's live — should be within the hour. Attached is the screenshot that shows the portal error message (same as before).

If it helps operationally, we're comfortable with the scoped token workaround and a manual merge afterward. Please go ahead once the alias is active and let us know the expected confirmation flow so we can watch for it in AP.

Appreciate the help — I'll update once the alias exists.

Best,
Liam
Senior AP Analyst
Solenovo Ltd.
